entries.title: Proverbs 15:1
segments: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:2
segments: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:3
segments: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:4
segments: A gentle tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a breaking of the spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:5
segments: A fool despiseth his father's correction; But he that regardeth reproof getteth prudence.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:6
segments: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:7
segments: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish [doeth] not so.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:8
segments: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:9
segments: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:10
segments: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; [And] he that hateth reproof shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:11
segments: Sheol and Abaddon are before Jehovah: How much more then the hearts of the children of men!

entries.title: Proverbs 15:12
segments: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:13
segments: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:14
segments: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:15
segments: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart [hath] a continual feast.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:16
segments: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:17
segments: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:18
segments: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:19
segments: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:20
segments: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:21
segments: Folly is joy to him that is void of wisdom;  But a man of understanding maketh straight his going.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:22
segments: Where there is no counsel, purposes are disappointed; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:23
segments: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!

entries.title: Proverbs 15:24
segments: To the wise the way of life [goeth] upward, That he may depart from Sheol beneath.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:25
segments: Jehovah will root up the house of the proud; But he will establish the border of the widow.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:26
segments: Evil devices are an abomination to Jehovah; But pleasant words [are] pure.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:27
segments: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth bribes shall live.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:28
segments: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:29
segments: Jehovah is far from the wicked; But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:30
segments: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; [And] good tidings make the bones fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:31
segments: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life Shall abide among the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:32
segments: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:33
segments: The fear of Jehovah is the instruction of wisdom; And before honor [goeth] humility.
